name: robots/isaac-sim__omniisaacgymenvs
title: OmniIsaacGymEnvs Cartpole (Isaac Sim 4.0 vectorised RL environment)
intro: OmniIsaacGymEnvs Cartpole (Isaac Sim 4.0 vectorised RL environment), adapted from isaac-sim/omniisaacgymenvs. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
